title: PP1 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   B. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Eid has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   D. Say Surah has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   C. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Eid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Arabic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. B — Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Eid; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Arabic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
